architecture_decisions.decision: Own gallery behavior in new focused modules: src/examples/catalog.js validates the single catalog and source roots; src/examples/list.js maps catalog entries to human and JSON payloads; src/examples/copy.js owns destination preflight, staging, cleanup, and receipt data; src/examples/index.js exposes listExamples and copyExample for CLI use. Keep src/cli.js as command router and output caller only, matching current central dispatch and catch envelope authority. Add packaged data under examples/sample-projects with the exact ten confirmed IDs from spec.md Confirmed Scope; package.json must include that gallery because current npm allowlist omits examples.
architecture_decisions.title: Module ownership

architecture_decisions.decision: Consumer inputs: launchdeck example list plus existing --json, --compact, --no-color flags from parseArgs; catalog loader; terminal columns/noColor from io/runtime. Producer outputs: human scan list of exactly ten entries, or one schemaVersion 1 success envelope command=example list with entries derived exactly from catalog fields id,title,stack,theme,requirements,ports,sourcePath. No prompts, no filesystem mutation, no Launchdeck config lookup. Compact must go through output.js compact handling rather than a separate schema authority.
architecture_decisions.title: List interface map

architecture_decisions.decision: Consumer inputs: launchdeck example copy [id] [destination], catalog lookup, optional TTY searchable selector only when id is omitted and json is false and terminal is TTY, and destination default path.resolve(cwd,id). Producer outputs: success receipt only after rename publishes the copied tree, or stable typed outcomes for unknown ID, missing ID without TTY, no-match, cancel, destination conflict, catalog/source invalid, copy failure, and rename failure. The command must not install dependencies, run projects, initialize Git, write .launchdeck.yml, access network, or touch Launchdeck runtime state.
architecture_decisions.title: Copy interface map

architecture_decisions.decision: Algorithm: load catalog and validate exact ten unique IDs; resolve source path below examples/sample-projects using path.resolve plus inside-root check; lstat source tree and reject symlinks, .launchdeck.yml, Launchdeck artifacts, and missing dirs; resolve destination and parent; reject existing destination of any type with lstat before staging; create a unique staging directory in the same destination parent using fs.mkdtemp with a hidden basename prefix; copy recursively into staging; recheck destination absence immediately before publish; fs.rename staging to destination; on any pre-rename or copy failure rm staging recursively and leave destination absent; on rename failure attempt rm staging and any owned unpublished destination only if safe, then return typed failure. Same-parent staging is required for same-filesystem rename; use a target-specific lock directory or lock file to reduce Launchdeck concurrent copies.
architecture_decisions.title: Atomic destination algorithm

architecture_decisions.decision: Do not couple sample sources to Launchdeck. Compatibility proof should be an external fixture that copies each sample to a temp dir, creates a reviewable candidate .launchdeck.yml outside the sample source, runs doctor and applicable setup/build/test/start/HTTP-or-API-health/stop, then cleans in finally. Gallery copy must not register projects or mutate .launchdeck runtime state as a side effect.
architecture_decisions.title: Lifecycle compatibility architecture

architecture_decisions.decision: Expand package files and repository contract tests so the actual npm tarball contains exactly the gallery plus existing package surfaces, with packed <=5 MiB and unpacked <=20 MiB. Current package scripts only run build-agent-plugins prepack and npm pack --dry-run; current CI package job only runs npm audit and npm run package:check on ubuntu. Add a package inventory gate that snapshots ten catalog sources and forbidden files, and add Windows/Linux native matrix checks for sample install/test/start/health/stop without making sample dependencies part of root npm ci.
architecture_decisions.title: Packaging and CI gates

architecture_decisions.decision: The implementation inventory is exactly vite-react-habit-tracker, nextjs-blog-manager, nestjs-url-shortener, fastapi-inventory, django-events, go-webhook-inbox, spring-boot-orders, aspnet-library-catalog, docker-compose-helpdesk, and node-python-issue-tracker under examples/sample-projects. This is not an extensibility promise; additions, replacement, merge, or reduction require reopening scope.
architecture_decisions.title: Confirmed ten-project inventory

architecture_decisions.decision: CA-001 protects npm size without reducing sample scope; CA-002 requires repairing failed sample/OS cells rather than skipping; CA-003 requires no published or staging residue after cancel/filesystem failure; CA-004 blocks release on repository/catalog/copied/tarball mismatch. The OCD observations carry these refs outcome-by-outcome in runtime-preserved observation entries.
